description.blurb: Alvaldi (formerly S/2004 S35 and Saturn LXV) is a natural satellite of Saturn discovered in 2004 and announced in 2019.
description.more: In mythology, Alvaldi is a Norse giant and the father of Thiazzi. He was rich in gold, and his sons divided it amongst themselves by taking a mouthful of gold each. Alvaldi is about 5 kilometres in diameter, and orbits Saturn in 1253.08 days, at an inclination of 177° to the ecliptic.
